topic: How the 2008 Icelandic banking collapse reshaped its currency

script.title: Icelandic banking collapse: how it reshaped the krona
script.hook: Did Iceland really lose its money?

scenes.text: Did Iceland really lose its money?

motion_action.headline: Did Iceland really lose its money?

scenes.text: In October two thousand eight all three major banks collapsed overnight.
The krona plummeted, losing over half its value against the euro.
Capital controls froze foreign accounts to stop capital flight.
Domestic prices spiked as imports became twice as expensive.
The Central Bank raised rates to eighteen percent to stabilise the economy.
By two thousand eleven the krona recovered, yet capital controls remain.
